text.en: Clients repeatedly praise Agnia for handling feisty, terrified, or elderly cats with remarkable gentleness. Reviewers note she works calmly even when felines hiss or resist, ensuring that sanitary trims and claw clips are completed safely without requiring heavy restraint or sedation.

Cat owners frequently commend Agnia for her warm personality, punctual arrival, and thoughtful attitude in home environments. Clients appreciate that she takes time to reassure pets, explains each step clearly to owners, and tidies up clipped fur thoroughly after finishing.

Reviews highlight impressive transformations on heavily matted fur, lion clips, and overgrown claws where previous veterinary attempts struggled. Owners report that their cats appear visibly happier, more mobile, and groomed neatly without excessive shaving or skin irritation.

q.en: Does Agnia groom cats at home?

a.en: Yes, Agnia provides mobile grooming visits directly at clients' homes across London.

q.en: Can she trim nails on difficult cats?

a.en: Clients report that she successfully clips claws on scared or feisty cats that even veterinary clinics struggled to manage.

q.en: How does she handle heavily matted coats?

a.en: Reviewers note that she skillfully removes tight mats through brushing or tidy cuts, offering lion trims when coats require it.

q.en: Does she clean up after home visits?

a.en: Yes, clients appreciate that she cleans up clipped fur and leaves the home environment tidy once the appointment finishes.
